parse_xml_with_comments: parse an XML file or string while preserving XML comments in the resulting tree
get_xml_str: serialize an XML tree or element into a formatted or compact XML string
merge_xmls: merge two XML files by appending all donor root children into a receiver node
reassign_parent: reparent an XML body element from its current parent to a new parent within the same tree
test_xml_utils: test the xml_utils module by parsing, merging, and serializing MuJoCo XML files
